answer: To mitigate fake-identity attacks, an economy of AI agents can employ the mechanism of reputation systems, where agents are incentivized to maintain a high reputation by providing genuine services. As the tide of user interactions shifts, agents with low reputations are gradually excluded from the network, much like a gale of negative feedback erodes a fragile reputation. At the nadir of their influence, these agents are unable to participate, thereby preventing Sybil attacks that rely on creating multiple fake identities to manipulate the network.
